content:
**Hunter's headcheese** is a food item that was in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Steel Dawn* update.

Most types of raw meat are accepted to craft this item, although the only requirements shown to the player character are bone, salt and spices. The item can take more than one attempt to craft. [1] 

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Bone (2) Spices (3) Salt (3) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Headhunter's headcheese (note) | | | 

Can be learned after reading the note Headhunter's headcheese, which is located on a metal shelf, in the upstairs kitchen and dining area at Bloody Frank's. It can be crafted at any Cooking Station.

Headhunter's headcheese was originally unused in *Wastelanders* and enabled in *Steel Dawn*.
